about_the_game:
You’ve probably seen the news. The entire country is waiting for answers in the Veronika case, the 16 years old girl whose life was taken in such a brutal way. The pressure is immense, but I trust that with your expertise, we can get to the truth.

In the first chapter, you get a detective job by sending your résumé, and now, on the first day, you have to deal with the country’s biggest case.

Our police are useless, so we’re calling you from abroad. We’ve prepared every case file, every shred of evidence and more importantly a brand-new, cutting-edge lie detector device for you. Examine the evidence, interrogate the suspect and deliver your verdict!

Based on a True Story.

Just Drink Your Coffee! It’s All in Your Head!

Due to air pollution and fatigue, if you do not take coffee, hallucinations begin, and you start seeing things everywhere, stemming from your subconscious.

It Gets Worse:

  • Fact checking with a lie detector device

  • Juggling cables to keep devices running

  • Search thorough case files and discover deeper conspiracies

  • Manage fatigue induced hallucinations through a coffee-making minigame

  • Navigating non-euclidean spaces

  • Hey … DO NOT get caught by THAT THING!

  • Your choice matters

  • Magic realism at its finest

  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (Dual-core) or equivalent,Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or better

short_description: At Sixes and Sevens is a PSX detective mystery horror game where you play as an investigator tasked with solving bizarre crime cases. The story unravels through a blend of interviews, computer-based investigations, and unsettling psychological elements.
